annotations.title: Change an in-app product's App Store image

description: Uploads the image the App Store shows with one product (where it's promoted, and on its page): PNG or JPEG of exactly 1024×1024 pixels, up to 10 MB, from an absolute path on this machine. It replaces the one there and goes to App Review with the product. While the product is with App Review, Ploa keeps the image and sends it itself once Apple has decided (the answer says so; nothing to retry). App Store only: Google Play keeps no image for a product. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_product_image
